[LSIG.1.5.2] `integral` is the dimensionally-correct counterpart of `sum`
for a rate sensor: `sum` over L/s readings yields `(L/s)·count`, which is
meaningless; `integral` yields litres. The compiler must back `integral`
with `SeriesBackendNumericIntegral` (§[LSIG.2.3]), distinct from any `sum` backing.
